mapper.sql: a.id, a.student_id, a.archive_type, a.archive_name, a.file_path, a.description, a.upload_date, a.operator, a.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , s.student_no AS student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.class_name AS class_name FROM student_archive a LEFT JOIN student s ON a.student_id = s.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT , s.student_no AS student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.class_name AS class_name FROM student_archive a LEFT JOIN student s ON a.student_id = s.id
AND a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.archive_type = #{archiveType} AND a.archive_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{archiveName}, '%') AND a.operator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operator}, '%') AND s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%') AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY a.upload_date DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_archive (student_id, archive_type, archive_name, file_path, description, upload_date, operator) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{archiveType}, #{archiveName}, #{filePath}, #{description}, #{uploadDate}, #{operator})
